global: Our caravan guards for {fief} are paid well, and the road bonus comes on top of the wage. Ask within.
Need hands for a siege of {fief}? I'll cover rations and a share of the spoils. Who's in?
Anyone fancy a raid on the {enemy_faction} wagon train? Split the take fifty-fifty, no questions asked.
My ledger says {enemy_faction} tolls have ruined the road to {fief}. Time to fix that, with swords.
{enemy_faction} thinks their walls will keep us out of {fief}. Their toll clerks will fold first, mark my words.
Hauling supplies to the siege camp at {fief} takes more backs than I have. Come earn some coin.
Honest question: would any of you join {my_faction} for a campaign? Pay is on time, I promise, mostly.
A good raid is a bad investment unless the escort list is full. Sign on with {my_faction} before we leave.
Forty crowns in advance for anyone who can hold a pike at {fief} by dawn. Hell of a deal, and I mean it.
Every war needs quartermasters, not just knights. If you can count sacks, {my_faction} needs you.
